# Cassette Player

- Source: https://polyhaven.com/a/cassette_player
- Downloaded variant: glTF, 1K textures
- Project wrapper: `res://scenes/props/polyhaven_cassette_player_visual.tscn`
- Production use: Dreamcore Schoolhouse and Endless Hotel audio props

Keep the upstream glTF, binary, and texture filenames together because the glTF references them by relative path.
